NTA, JEE (Main) 2026 Session 2 final answer key of B.E./B.Tech on which result compiled, Exam Date 02.04.2026, Shift First (page 1)

notes: Previous-year questions from NTA's JEE (Main) 2026 paper of 2 April 2026, Shift 1 (B.E./B.Tech), ingested with pyq-ingest. Stems, options, statements and list items keep NTA's English wording exactly; NTA published this paper in English only, so the Hindi is our translation (hi_source: translation) and must be reviewed as such. Answers are NTA's final key (result-compiled, Session 2); our own solutions reach the same answer for every question in this file. Question ids 9001 and up mark ingested PYQs.

stem.en: Let $x$ and $y$ be real numbers such that $50\left(\frac{2x}{1+3i}-\frac{y}{1-2i}\right)=31+17i$, $i=\sqrt{-1}$. Then the value of $10(x-3y)$ is :
stem.hi: माना $x$ तथा $y$ ऐसी वास्तविक संख्याएँ हैं कि $50\left(\frac{2x}{1+3i}-\frac{y}{1-2i}\right)=31+17i$, $i=\sqrt{-1}$ है। तब $10(x-3y)$ का मान है :

feynman.en: Rationalise both fractions so the left side becomes one complex number, then match real parts and imaginary parts separately.
feynman.hi: दोनों भिन्नों का परिमेयकरण कीजिए ताकि बायाँ पक्ष एक सम्मिश्र संख्या बन जाए, फिर वास्तविक और काल्पनिक भागों की अलग-अलग तुलना कीजिए।

steps.en: $\frac{2x}{1+3i}=\frac{x(1-3i)}{5}$ and $\frac{y}{1-2i}=\frac{y(1+2i)}{5}$, so the left side is $10\left[(x-y)-(3x+2y)i\right]$.
